Counsel for Petitioner :- Girish Kumar Pande,Prashant Pandey Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Ratnesh Chandra Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for petitioner, learned Standing Counsel for the State and Sri Ratnesh Chandra, learned counsel for the Lucknow Development Authority.

2. Petitioner has approached this Court challenging the notification dated 10.7.2023 under Section 4 of the Right to Fair Compensation Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Objection of petitioner is on the ground that description of property in the same is incorrect as the name of Tehsil is wrongly mentioned as Sarojni Nagar while the same should be Mohanlalganj.

Dr. Bheemsen Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9404134/

entities.text: Bheemsen Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner himself has filed a public notice dated 1.9.2023 by which persons at large have been invited for public hearing on the social impact assessment report, the same being conducted by the Tehsildar, Mohanlalganj, Lucknow.
4. Learned counsel for petitioner submits that petitioner has already filed his objection before the Tehsildar with regard to the mistake committed in the said notification.
5. It is expected that the Tehsildar concerned shall consider and decide the objections filed by petitioner expeditiously in accordance with law while taking a final decision in the matter.

6. With the aforesaid, present writ petition stands disposed of.
[Om Prakash Shukla,J.]
